portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.sub: Examples across construction, marketing, and consulting — each with a short challenge, what we did, and the outcome.

01.title: Office renovation built for daily use
01.summary: Updated layout and materials for everyday work while keeping the organization’s character.
01.challenge: The existing space felt tight, impractical, and outdated.
01.work: Coordinated design and build through partners, sequencing work to minimize disruption.
01.result: A more usable workspace with clearer brand presence and progress that stayed on plan.

02.title: Home extension for practical living space
02.summary: Added usable area that fits daily life while staying coherent with the existing structure.
02.challenge: More space was needed, with concerns about structure, budget, and timeline.
02.work: Assessed scope, presented options, and delivered the extension through specialized partners.
02.result: New living space that works day to day, with clear scope and timeline.

03.title: Social media system for consistent brand voice
03.summary: Defined brand tone, content calendar, and visual direction the team can keep using.
03.challenge: Posting was inconsistent, messaging drifted, and results were hard to track.
03.work: Set brand guidelines, planned content, and produced ready-to-use photos and video.
03.result: The team communicates more consistently with a direction that can scale.

04.title: Photo and video that explain services clearly
04.summary: Created media that presents services and project atmosphere in a straightforward way.
04.challenge: Existing media did not reflect quality and made it hard to explain services to new clients.
04.work: Shot photography and video, then packaged assets for the website and online channels.
04.result: Ready-to-use media that helps customers understand services faster.

05.title: Project development plan with shared language
05.summary: Aligned goals, audience, and development steps so the team moved in one direction.
05.challenge: Information was scattered and the team did not share the same project goals.
05.work: Analyzed the brief, built a development framework, and defined internal communication.
05.result: The team gained a shared reference plan and clearer next decisions.

06.title: Sales planning aligned with marketing
06.summary: Connected the offer, value story, and customer channels into one coherent approach.
06.challenge: Strong services were hard to sell because value messaging and sales sequence were unclear.
06.work: Built a sales-planning framework and marketing direction the teams could use together.
06.result: Sales and marketing shared one direction and spoke with customers more precisely.
